research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TMRW Sports is engaged in developing a golf simulator system and method, which includes a computing system with real-life golf courses stored in memory, a projector, and a screen. This system projects simulations of real-life golf holes, enhancing the sports experience through advanced technology. This aligns with TMRW Sports' focus on integrating sports, media, and technology to create innovative solutions.
